eyebrow: Step 2 & 3 · A custom metric and a trace span
code:
checkout_duration = meter.create_histogram(
    name="order_checkout_duration_seconds"
)

with tracer.start_as_current_span("charge_card") as span:
    span.set_attribute("order.id", order.id)
    response = payment_gateway.charge(order.total)
    span.set_attribute("payment.status", response.status)
caption: The histogram measures checkout logic the platform can't see; the span isolates the riskiest call.

eyebrow: Step 4 · Wiring it into Azure Monitor

steps.label: 1. configure_azure_monitor()
steps.sub: Called once at startup with the Application Insights connection string

steps.label: 2. All exporters share one pipe
steps.sub: Logs, the histogram, and every span flow through the same context

steps.label: 3. No per-signal setup
steps.sub: One connection string, not three separate exporter configurations

code:
union AppTraces, AppMetrics, AppDependencies
| where TimeGenerated > ago(15m)
| where OperationId == "7e3b2f9a1c4d"
| project TimeGenerated, ItemType, Name, Message
| order by TimeGenerated asc
caption: One OperationId pulls back the log, the metric, and the span for one real checkout, in order.
